entities.summary: Siswondo Parman or more popularly known such as in streets name as S. Parman, was a soldier in the Indonesian Army. He was kidnapped from his home in Jakarta by members of the 30 September Movement in the early hours of October 1. He was later killed at Lubang Buaya.
